title: Worked Solution
text: To find $$P(D\vert{}C)$$, identify the conditional probability definition $$P(D\vert{}C) = \frac{P(C \text{ AND } D)}{P(C)}$$, where the condition $$C$$ becomes the new sample space denominator. Plugging in the joint probability $$P(C \text{ AND } D) = 0.225$$ and the conditioning probability $$P(C) = 0.75$$ gives $$\frac{0.225}{0.75}$$, which simplifies to 0.3.
